title: Foundry evaluation dataset
description: A dataset used for evaluation or optimization. Items in a datasets array may be inline or a $ref to an external file. A dataset is either local (local_uri points to a .jsonl file) or remote (name references an already-uploaded dataset in the Foundry project).

name.description: Dataset name. Used to reference the dataset from evaluation-suites.

version.description: Version identifier for the dataset. When omitted, the latest version is used.

local_uri.description: Relative path to a local dataset file (typically .jsonl). The extension uploads this file to the Foundry project on deploy. When omitted, the dataset must already exist remotely.
